interactives.label: Garden well
interactives.text: Cold water from the garden well.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: The house seal
interactives.text: A countersign is checked against the seal-room book. What is made under the guild hall is entered twice, and counts twice.

interactives.label: Training post
interactives.text: The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Reading
interactives.text: The arcade's under-room. Books read three times as fast.

interactives.label: The post
interactives.text: The post came back unopened. The reeve says that is the message.

interactives.label: Ferries
interactives.text: Westhaven's berths: one to Crownwater, one to Amberwood. The crossing is a boat, not a road.

interactives.label: Warm spring
interactives.text: The spring is warm and mineral; it restores you.

interactives.label: Butts
interactives.text: The butts list your recent combat results.

interactives.label: The seal
interactives.text: The false countersign was chalked. The chalk washed off. The seal did not.

interactives.label: The escrow
interactives.text: Someone probed the escrow with a returned letter. It was never opened, and it never needed to be.

interactives.label: The wreck
interactives.text: The wreck assessor's book lists a hull that never sailed.

interactives.label: The Cathedral Reliquary
interactives.text: The cathedral's relic room, opened with a shell.

interactives.label: Ward post
interactives.text: Nothing casts within these stones. The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Cistern
interactives.text: Rainwater from the cistern.

interactives.label: Breath
interactives.text: Rest here and the breath comes back twice as fast.

interactives.label: Trade
interactives.text: The customs house weighs what walks and what rolls. A third added to a wagon on an island that sells bread and rope is not rope.

sections.name: The Wrack Hollow
sections.label: A cave mouth the tide leaves open for an hour a day.
sections.note: A sea cave under the watch where the wrack piles and the shells are whole.

sections.name: The Ropewalk Garden
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: Flax and cotton in beds under the ropewalk, where the ropemakers grow their own.

sections.name: The Bonded Cache
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: A warehouse cellar off the bonded vaults: chest, bench, and ore the customs never weighed.

sections.name: The Guild Vault
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: The guild's strongroom, opened with a stored account's token.

sections.name: The Mole Pit
sections.label: An iron drain grate, its bolts drawn.
sections.note: A casemate under the bastion where the militia pens boar and rams.

sections.name: The Arcade School
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Where the customs clerks learn their hands.

sections.name: The Lamp Rock Spring
sections.label: A loose stone in the rock; something moves behind it.
sections.note: A warm seep under the light's rock, reached from the landward foot of the mole; the keepers bathe there.

sections.name: The Shipyard Butts
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: A long shed under the slips with butts and crabs at the far end.

sections.name: The Cathedral Reliquary
sections.label: A shrine slab with fresh scratches where it has been slid aside.
sections.note: The cathedral's relic room, opened with a shell.

sections.name: The City Gate Well
sections.label: An iron drain grate, its bolts drawn.
sections.note: The gate's old cistern swallows spells; the rams penned there are honest work.

sections.name: The Spire Focus
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Under the high spire the ether pools; spells cost half.

sections.name: The Smugglers' Run
sections.label: A cave mouth the tide leaves open for an hour a day.
sections.note: The smugglers' run under the strait, out by Amberwood's harbour.

sections.name: The Haven Waystone
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Four stones under the fish market. An iron rune wakes them.

sections.name: The Lighthouse Eyrie
sections.label: An arch so grown with vine it reads as hedge.
sections.note: A pocket in the lighthouse footing over the sea.

secrets.note: Each section is one secret. The client shows a player only the section they stand in; the server places the arrival, the areas, the spawns and the harvest nodes from this block.

provenance.geometry: authored with the secret rooms kit over the shared toolkit

notes: 14 secrets of Westhaven Secrets on one map with void between them; which one a player gets is which feature of the ground above they used.
